Richmond (Checklist/ DPAP)

Contact: Biliana Velkova | Public Art Planner

  • Public art budget based on sq.ft
  • $1.02 Residential
  • $0.52 Commercial Office

Burnaby (PPAP + DPAP)

Port Moody (PPAP + DPAP)

Contact: Sara Graham | Community Arts Coordinator /

0.5% of construction costs

  • DPAP reviewed by City (PA & Planning) -approved prior to issuance of DP applicationcopy & invite Sara Graham  to panel meetings

City and District of North Vancouver (DPAP)

Contact: Lori Phillips | Public Art Officer

  • 1% of gross construction costs as per the building permit-determined by the City or District
  • Admin costs no more than 20% of budget
  • The public art process begins  with the Rezoning Process. meeting with the Public Art Coordinator, Developer and Ballard to discuss the public art site location and opportunity. The Public Art Plan is presented to the Public Art Committee and becomes part of the Rezoning Application.
  • No contingency,
  •  signage only $1,000 **artist must include in budget
  • Submit Public Art Plan Minimum 1 week in advance of meeting. The more time you can give Lori the better. Aim for 2 weeks if possible.
  • If EOI posting on public website required, include costs in public art budget
